**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Technical Feasibility & Dependencies**
Note: BeenHere requires zero third-party dependencies (Python standard library only). Does this feature require standard library capabilities, or can it be implemented as a pure protocol/rubric?

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or prior art examples here.
